props.backstory:
เขาเป็นนักสำรวจจากองค์กรเอลิโอไนย์ ได้รับคำสั่งจากประธานให้มาดูแลการขนส่งของกลาง ด้วยรู้อยู่แล้วว่าเจ้าหน้าที่รัฐที่ไม่มีความรู้เฉพาะทางคงไม่ได้ใส่ใจเท่าไร แล้วขนส่งอย่างลวกๆจนอาจเกิดความเสียหายก่อนได้ปล่อยขายแน่ๆ

ประธานบอกเขาว่าจะรอซื้อของกลางจากรัฐพวกนี้ไปใช้ในการวิจัยในองค์กร เจาะจงไปที่ไอเท็มชีวภาพ เช่น เพชรมังกร หัวใจนางเงือก เกล็ดอสูรทะเล เครื่องประดับกระดูกวิเศษ ฯลฯ

ซาร์โดผู้ขยันขันแข็ง ชอบสำรวจธรรมชาติ และเป็นผู้ใช้เวทโลหะมือดีคนหนึ่งขององค์กร จะพยายามดูแลของพวกนี้ให้ไปถึงโดยสวัสดิภาพให้ได้

props.name: Sardo

0.description:
At the start of a conflict scene, you may spend 20 Mind Points to reveal that you set traps  in the area;

if you do, choose a status effect among [dazed], [shaken], [slow], and [weak]. 


"Every enemy present on the scene" whose current Insight die size is equal to or lower than yours loses an amount of Hit Points and Mind Points equal to 【your Skill Level in Resourceful, multiplied by 5】= 15

and suffers the chosen status effect

0.passive_description:
Together with the rest of your group, create a rare custom weapon (page XXX) worth 
1200 zenit or less.


This weapons should have an especially unusual and technological appearance; it can 
be a good idea to make it a firearm weapon and determine that similar items are rare 
and mysterious in your world.

Once per session (approximately four hours of play), the Game Master may give you 
1 Fabula Point in order to have sudden complications arise due to the unique nature 
of the weapon (such as strange machines reacting to its presence, or monsters drawn 
to the special energy it emits). However, the weapon cannot be destroyed, damaged, 
lost or stolen without your permission as a Player.

1.passive_description:
Requirements: you must have acquired the Resourceful Skill (see Wayfarer).
At the start of a conflict scene, you may spend 20 Mind Points to reveal you set traps 
in the area; if you do, choose a status effect among dazed, shaken, slow, and weak. 
Every enemy present on the scene whose current Insight die size is equal to or lower 
than yours loses an amount of Hit Points and Mind Points equal to 【your Skill Level 
in Resourceful, multiplied by 5】 and suffers the chosen status effect. The Hit Point 
and Mind Point losses increase by 5 if you are level 20 or higher, or by 10 if you are 
level 40 or higher.
Additionally, your attacks with bows deal extra damage equal to 【1 + your Skill Level 
in Resourceful】 as long as you have no martial armor equipped.

2.passive_description:
You spend your time looking for useful items; describe how, then roll 1d6.
1. Ouch! You do not recover Hit Points and Mind Points during this rest.
2. Not what I was looking for... The target regains 1 Inventory Point.
3-5. Hoho, this can be useful! The target regains 3 Inventory Points.
6. Jackpot! You find an amount of zenit equal to 【your character level × 50】.

3.passive_description:
Once before the next rest, when you lose Hit Points for whatever reason, you may 
choose to halve that HP loss.

0.description:
When you perform an Accuracy Check, you may replace one of the Attribute dice with 
Insight (such as 【INS + INS】 for a pistol or 【INS + MIG】 for a waraxe).

1.description:
At the start of a conflict, you may spend up to 【SL × 5】 Mind Points. For every 5 Mind 
Points you spend this way, choose one option: choose a creature you can see and the 
GM reveals one of their Traits; or name a damage type and choose a creature you can 
see, and the GM reveals that creature's Affinity towards that damage type.

2.description:
When you roll a 13 or higher on a Check performed to investigate a creature, item or 
location — this includes using the Study action during a conflict — you may ask the 
Game Master up to 【SL】 questions concerning the subject of your investigation. You 
may ask these questions immediately or save them for later; whenever you ask one of 
these questions, the Game Master will answer truthfully and you will describe your 
character's deductive process.
This Skill may only be used once on the same creature, item or location

3.description:
When you perform a ranged attack, you may spend 10 Mind Points to choose one 
option: the attack gains multi (2); or you increase the attack's multi property by one, 
up to a maximum of multi (3).

4.description:
When you hit one or more targets with a ranged attack that would deal damage, you 
may have the attack deal no damage. If you do, choose one option: inflict shaken on 
each target hit by the attack; or inflict slow on each target hit by the attack; or each 
target hit by the attack loses 【SL × 10】 Mind Points. Describe your maneuver!

5.description: You gain a bonus equal to 【SL】 to all Accuracy Checks with ranged weapons.

6.description:
When you perform the Guard action, if you choose not to provide cover to another 
creature, you may choose one option: the next ranged attack you perform before the 
end of the current scene will deal 【SL × 2】 extra damage; or you may immediately 
perform a free attack with a bow or firearm you have equipped, treating your High Roll 
(HR) as 0 when calculating damage dealt by this attack

7.description:
When your group journeys on the world map, you will make a discovery on a roll of 
【SL + 1】 or lower on the travel roll (instead of only on a 1).

8.description:
You reduce the die rolled for your travel rolls by one size (to a minimum of d6).
If multiple characters have this Skill, the effects are not cumulative.

9.description: You recover 【SL】 Inventory Points after each travel roll (see page 106).
